title: Video by jason_swet
description:
What even is a “BIG IDEA”?? 
It’s often too nebulous.
Agencies love to talk about them. Recruiters will say they are looking for “conceptual art directors” who can think of “big ideas”.
But hardly anyone explains to young art directors & designers what exactly a big idea should look like.

The Idea Sizing Chart made it all more tangible for me.

Does this help simplify it for you?
